subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

It is quite difficult to __make on__ what this doctor writes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'make out'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate phrasal verb for the underlined part is** 'make out'.**
 
• **Make out: **manage with some difficulty to see or hear someone or something. (किसी को या कुछ को देखने या सुनने के लिए कुछ कठिनाई के साथ प्रबंधन करें)
